## Context / Problem
The runner attaches per-call usage to every result (`result["_usage"]`, src/rebar/llm/runner.py:543) but Pass-1 discards it: passes.pass1_chunk, passes.pass1_container, and passes.pass1_isf return findings lists only, so BatchRunResult.outputs (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/production_batch_runner.py:167-176) carries no usage key and plan-review coverage.metrics has call counts but no token totals for the most expensive pass (the gap is documented at src/rebar/llm/code_review/finalize.py:139-149; _attach_plan_review_metrics currently reconstructs only det_ms/llm_ms/llm_calls timing proxies). Per-criterion request counts are extracted (runner.py:_extract_usage) but never persisted, blocking data-driven criterion demotion decisions.

## Approach
run_pass1 does not call runner.run directly — calls flow through _chunk -> sizing.pass1_with_ladder -> passes.pass1_chunk (and the container/ISF variants). The usage is threaded through that chain as a coordinated internal-API change, all callers updated atomically in this one change (these functions are private to the plan_review package; no external consumers): (1) passes.pass1_chunk, passes.pass1_container, and passes.pass1_isf change return type from list[dict] to (list[dict], dict) — findings plus the call's _usage dict; their complete caller set, each updated here: sizing.pass1_with_ladder (chunk path), pass1._chunk, pass1's container fan-out (_timed_pairing path), and pass1's ISF invocation. (2) run_pass1 accumulates an aggregate sum plus a per-criterion map {llm_calls, requests, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens}. (3) The prerequisite finder runs in ProductionBatchRunner.run() via prerequisites.run_focused_finder, which returns (records, findings) with no usage — it is extended to return (records, findings, usage), its callers updated in the same change (scope includes src/rebar/llm/plan_review/prerequisites.py), and that usage is merged into the aggregate before emitting BatchRunResult.outputs["_usage"]. (4) _attach_plan_review_metrics (src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py:249+) is EXTENDED to fold the new token totals from the batch step output into coverage.metrics alongside its existing timing fields. (5) The per-criterion map is persisted into the REVIEW_RESULT sidecar coverage (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/sidecar.py). Alternative rejected: post-hoc parsing of the REBAR_USAGE_LOG JSONL — opt-in, not always present, and not keyed by criterion.

## Scope
src/rebar/llm/plan_review/passes.py, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/sizing.py, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/pass1.py, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/prerequisites.py, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/production_batch_runner.py, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/sidecar.py, src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py, tests/unit/workflow/test_pass1_usage.py (new, beside tests/unit/workflow/test_production_batch_runner.py).

## Testing
Unit with FakeRunner emitting stub _usage dicts: aggregate totals equal the sum over chunk, agent, container, ISF, and prerequisite calls; per-criterion map keys match the routed criteria; sidecar payload carries the map; coverage.metrics gains the token totals through the extended _attach_plan_review_metrics; a runner result without _usage degrades to zeros without error; the full existing pass1/batch-runner test suites pass with the new return shapes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] After a review, coverage.metrics contains input/output/cache token totals that include Pass-1 and prerequisite calls (checked: `pytest tests/unit/workflow/test_pass1_usage.py` summing FakeRunner stub usage).
- [ ] The sidecar coverage carries a per-criterion usage map for every routed criterion (checked: sidecar payload unit test).
- [ ] Missing _usage on any call degrades to zero contribution (checked: unit test).
- [ ] Every caller of the three changed pass functions and of run_focused_finder is updated in this change and the existing pass1, batch-runner, and finalize test suites pass unmodified in behavior (checked: full `pytest tests/unit/workflow/` run).
